key_findings: HIIT relieved MIA-OA pain in rats and shifted spinal microglia from M1 to M2, lowering SP, IL-6, Glu and c-Fos.
Pharmacological Jak2/Stat3 activation (C-A1) blunted HIIT's effects, implicating Jak2/Stat3 in HIIT-driven microglial polarisation.
